result.title: Autonomous Analysis of Thermoelectric Materials Big Data by Multi-Agentic AI and Construction of a Knowledge Base and Specialized AI
result.comment: 74 pages (28 pages main text with 5 figures; 46 pages Supplementary Information with 7 Supplementary Notes, 10 Supplementary Tables and 3 Supplementary Figures). Analysis records, Supplementary Data 1-5 and code are available from the corresponding authors upon request
result.summary: Extracting knowledge from large databases of experimental materials data requires repeated analyses and reusable records of their choices and results. We developed Multi-Agentic AI (MAA), a multi-agent system in which AI agents with distinct roles analyze experimental thermoelectric data under predefined instructions and quality checks, saving analysis records traceable to their sources. In four experiments varying theme and cycle counts, we measured what accumulated in these records. In the largest experiment (100 analyses across 10 themes and 10 cycles), concept co-occurrences were concentrated within themes, vocabulary was shared across themes and some relation descriptions were first detected in later cycles. A specialized AI that searches this experiment's knowledge bases and reads their analysis records answered materials questions with cited sources. Retrospective checks, including tracing an answer generated with a preliminary corpus back to the source data, exposed errors: traceability makes errors findable but not absent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建多智能体系统，在预设指令与质量检查下分析热电材料实验大数据，保存可溯源的分析记录，并在多主题、多轮次实验中考察概念共现与词汇积累；另建可检索知识库的专用 AI，带引用回答材料问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关系，但其多轮分析中可复用记录、来源溯源以及「可溯源使错误可发现而非消失」的观察，可能为 latent 推理的中间状态记录、证据归因与停止决策评价提供思路，可供核查。
